tool.name: compare_annotations.py
tool.gate_role: Compare record-level measurements between the algorithm and the LUDB annotation-derived reference (doc 05 B: Phases 1 and 3).
tool.cadence: Every release when annotation or fiducial code changed; otherwise manual quarterly audit (doc 06).

datasets.name: LUDB
datasets.subset_rule: All 200 LUDB records (numeric order), passed explicitly via --records. Only the machine-readable --batch-reports mode is used; the plotting modes are interactive/visual and not gateable. LUDB is read from the fixed path <tool dir>/data/lobachevsky-...-1.0.1/data.

record_schema_note: legacy ecgfeat export (pre-ECG-Record); no record schema is exercised by these tools at this revision

determinism.ungated_note: runtime/wall-clock values; environment-dependent, not gated, not a result difference
